options.horsingaround_shoulder.title: Over the Shoulder
options.horsingaround_shoulder.subtitle: Where the camera sits when you're in third person.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.enabled.t: Off: third person goes back to Minecraft's own camera, straight behind your head.
Which shoulder the camera looks over. You can also swap it any time with the Swap Shoulder key (O).
options.horsingaround_shoulder.aiming: Aiming a bow, crossbow or trident
options.horsingaround_shoulder.foot_dist: How far behind you the camera sits while walking around.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.foot_side: How far to the side of your head the camera sits.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.foot_heig: How far above your eyes the camera sits.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.height_fo: How quickly the camera follows you up and down when you jump or take a step. Lower is smoother.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.aim_dista: How far behind you the camera sits while you aim.
How far to the side of your head the camera sits while you aim.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.ride_dist: How far back the camera sits while riding, compared with Horsing Around's riding camera as designed (its own distance setting doesn't apply here). It still pulls back as your horse speeds up.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.ride_side: How far to the side the camera sits while riding.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.ride_heig: How far above your eyes the camera sits while riding.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.ride_boun: How much of the horse's stride the camera rides along with. Off keeps it perfectly steady.
options.horsingaround_shoulder.transitio: How quickly the camera glides between walking, aiming and riding, and to the other shoulder.
